text:
Amanda (AE): Hey team — LumenPay wants to do a 2-week POC. They need SSO + SCIM + RBAC mappings. Can we confirm what we need to hand them for an internal security review?
Josh (SE): Quick list: SAML metadata, SP ACS URL, entityID, example assertion (NameID format), and a SCIM service account with scoped token.
Maria (Security): Also require our security questionnaire filled and the encryption / key management section called out. I'll need SCIM transport details (TLS, mTLS option?) and how we store SCIM tokens.
Tayla (LumenPay): From our side: Ok with SAML, PingFederate on our side. For SCIM we need group sync and delta support, plus a way to map SCIM groups -> product roles.
Josh (SE): We support SCIM 2.0 delta. For POC we can enable group sync and provide a sample mapping file. Example mapping snippet:
```
{
  "group_to_role": {
    "engineering@lumenpay.com": "developer",
    "ops@lumenpay.com": "operator"
  },
  "user_attrs": {
    "email": "emails[0].value",
    "name": "displayName"
  }
}
```
Amanda (AE): Pricing question from procurement — will SSO/SCIM be part of Hosted plan or need Dedicated? They asked if SCIM service accounts are charged differently.
Josh (SE): Hosted includes SSO & SCIM for standard accounts. Dedicated/VPC only needed if they require private network or on-prem connect. No extra per-scim-account fee, just usage and any Dedicated contract.
Maria (Security): For compliance we need to confirm retention policy for audit logs and where logs live (hosted vs private). Amanda please flag whether they need logs retained >1 year.
Tayla (LumenPay): Need 13 months retention and audit trail showing who provisioned RBAC changes.
Amanda (AE): Noted. Maria, can we meet those retention asks on Hosted?
Maria (Security): Hosted can do 13 months as an add-on (enterprise retention). Need legal signoff + DPA update.
Josh (SE): For the SAML config with PingFederate, ask them to send metadata XML. We'll provide our SP metadata at: https://redwood-inference.com/sso/metadata/lumenpay (temp). Also note NameID formats supported: emailAddress, persistent, transient. Recommend emailAddress for provisioning.
Tayla (LumenPay): Can you support domain verification so we can auto-claim users for role mapping?
Josh (SE): Yes — we support domain proofing via TXT DNS record + over email domain claim. For multi-tenant customers we can whitelist specific domains. We'll provide instructions.
Amanda (AE): POC logistics: propose test tenant + 10 seats, SCIM sync of 2 groups, SSO configured, and 1-hour validation call on day 3. Tayla, ok?
Tayla (LumenPay): Sounds good. We'll create a Ping test tenant and give you metadata by EOD Tue.
infra-bot: security questionnaire created: https://redwood.company/infosec/questionnaire/LP-POC — assign to Maria and LumenPay contact.
Maria (Security): I'll kick off the questionnaire and add the retention clause. Amanda, for the contract ask for enterprise retention + SOC2 addendum.
Amanda (AE): I'll loop in legal and billing. Josh, can you draft a tiny runbook for the POC steps (SAML, SCIM token, group mapping) so the customer can follow?
Josh (SE): Yup — I'll drop a short runbook and a test curl for SCIM token exchange:
```bash
curl -X GET \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/scim/Users
```
Amanda (AE): Perfect. Any blockers?
Maria (Security): One small blocker — LumenPay uses strict IP allowlisting. If they want hosted, we need to ensure our egress IPs are allowed or they use SAML+SCIM over our outbound range for the POC. If not, Dedicated is needed.
Tayla (LumenPay): We can add the hosted egress IP range for the POC. Please send it.
Josh (SE): Sending ranges in a follow-up DM. Also adding TTL guidance for DNS TXT domain proof.
Amanda (AE): Great — I'll update the deal doc and send a calendar invite for the kickoff. :thumbsup:
Tayla (LumenPay): Thanks all.
Amanda (AE): Closing loop — next actions: 1) LumenPay sends metadata + add hosted egress IPs, 2) Redwood produces runbook + SCIM mapping, 3) Security questionnaire starts. Back to you, Josh & Maria.
